subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Shakuntala Devi was born on 4th November 1929. In her childhood she ________to school.
solution:
The correct option is**: had never been.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence "Shakuntala Devi was born on 4th November 1929. In her childhood she ________to school." i**s in the past tense. We need to use the past perfect tense to talk about an action that happened before another action in the past.**
 
• "Had never been" is the past perfect tense, which is used to describe an action that did not happen before another time in the past.​
 
• The **past perfect tense is formed by using "had" + the past participle of the verb.**
 
• In this case,** the past participle of the verb "go" is "gone."**
 
• Thus, the sentence correctly reads: "Shakuntala Devi was born on 4th November 1929. In her childhood she had never been to school."

*​*Therefore, the correct answer is 'option 3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Never gone"** does not fit the structure of the sentence properly, as it would require an auxiliary verb to be grammatically correct. 
 
• **"Went never" **is not grammatically correct in this context. 
 
• **"Ever been**" does not convey the negative meaning required by the sentence.
